nodes.prompt:
TASK: Implement the typed native Ferryx Remote active-desktop-terminal contract, safe mobile workspace/worktree selection request bridge, and active-only attach authorization with tests.
DELIVERABLE: A RED-to-GREEN implementation changing only /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/src-tauri/src/remote/**, /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/src-tauri/src/ipc/remote.rs, /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/src-tauri/src/lib.rs, and direct Rust tests; return exact RED and GREEN test commands/results plus a concise requirement map.
SCOPE: Read current Remote, worktree registry/types, terminal service, and IPC. Write ONLY the listed native paths. Preserve pairing/auth. Add an in-memory active desktop selection, updated through a desktop IPC command; store only safe workspaceId, safe worktree slug/label, and optional backend sessionId — NEVER a local absolute path, cwd, or repoRoot. GET /api/v1/sessions and workspace state must expose at most the declared active, running session. /api/v1/terminal/:sessionId must return forbidden for any session other than the declared active one, even if the PTY exists. Add an authenticated control-only mobile selection route that validates workspace/worktree identity from the registry and emits a Tauri desktop event carrying safe IDs/slug. View permission must be rejected. Do not edit ui/**, docs/**, .omo/**, manifests, git state, or unrelated source.
VERIFY: First add a focused test that fails on the pre-change code for background-session exclusion/attach denial/selection permission or safe event. Capture its failing assertion. Then make it green with targeted cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml remote (or narrower named tests), cargo fmt --check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml, and cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml; all must exit 0 after the change.
STOP WHEN: Native code and direct tests prove no background session can list, state-render, or attach; safe Control-only selection reaches a desktop event; and all listed checks are green.

nodes.prompt:
TASK: Implement the Ferryx desktop focused-terminal publisher and consume the safe mobile workspace/worktree selection event with existing desktop behavior.
DELIVERABLE: A RED-to-GREEN implementation changing only /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/App.tsx, /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/lib/tauri.ts, and direct App test files; return exact RED/GREEN results and the focus derivation map.
SCOPE: Read App, ui/src/lib/types.ts, state/layout helpers, terminal split view, and tauri bridge. Write ONLY App.tsx, lib/tauri.ts, and their direct tests. Derive the focused backend session from focused group -> active tab -> terminal-only tab -> active leaf -> leaf local session -> TerminalSession.backendSessionId. Publish a safe payload containing workspace ID, existing branch/worktree label or slug, and backend session ID to the native IPC whenever relevant desktop focus/worktree state changes. Clear active terminal for a browser tab/no valid terminal. Listen for native remote_selection_requested carrying only { workspaceId, worktreeSlug? }, then invoke existing project/worktree actions to activate that desktop context. Do not publish/display absolute paths; do not edit ui/src/remote/**, Rust, docs, manifests, git state, or unrelated files.
VERIFY: First add a direct test that fails before production code for focused leaf mapping or selection-event application. Capture RED. Then rerun it green with cd /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui && npx vitest run src/App.test.tsx --maxWorkers=1 and npx tsc --noEmit; both must exit 0.
STOP WHEN: Focus publication maps exactly one desktop terminal or null, mobile selection uses existing desktop actions, RED-to-GREEN evidence is captured, and scope checks are green.

nodes.prompt:
TASK: Replace Ferryx Remote's multi-session mobile presentation with a singular server-declared desktop-terminal mirror and a safe workspace/worktree context selector.
DELIVERABLE: A RED-to-GREEN implementation changing only /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/remote/** and direct Remote tests; return exact evidence plus a summary of visible states and privacy guarantees.
SCOPE: Read all ui/src/remote/** and Remote client APIs. Write ONLY files under ui/src/remote/**. Treat server workspace state as authoritative: render exactly its optional active terminal, never a background session even if malformed input includes one. Render compact current workspace/worktree breadcrumb plus accessible selector rows using only safe workspaceId and worktree label/slug. On selection, POST the safe selection request API, show pending state, refresh/confirm server-declared result, and present a useful no-focused-terminal state. Retain pairing/auth. Do not render absolute local paths, repo roots, CWDs, titles from invalid hidden sessions, old Orca branding, or any arbitrary session switcher. Do not edit App, lib/tauri, Rust, docs, manifests, git state, or files outside ui/src/remote.
VERIFY: First add a Remote UI test that fails before production implementation where workspace state contains a focused session plus a distinct background session; assert one terminal only, safe selector pending/confirmation/no-focus, and path non-rendering. Capture RED. Then run cd /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui && npx vitest run src/remote/RemoteUI.test.tsx --maxWorkers=1 green.
STOP WHEN: The Remote UI receives one declared terminal, renders only it with a safe desktop-style context selector and all required state tests pass green.

TASK: Independently verify the joined Ferryx active-desktop-terminal mirror after the three producer lanes finish.
DELIVERABLE: A read-only requirement-to-evidence report with exact commands, exit codes, relevant output, changed-file scope check, and first concrete failure if any.

Preserve public Ferryx branding.

PASS only if every command exits 0 and direct code inspection confirms every invariant.
STOP WHEN: Return PASS with complete command evidence or the first specific failed invariant; do not make changes.

nodes.prompt:
TASK: Perform browser-facing QA of the changed Ferryx Remote mobile UI using an available real browser driver and a controlled local fixture; do not control the desktop app.
DELIVERABLE: Read-only QA result with literal setup/action log, screenshot/artifact paths, visible PASS/FAIL observations for one focused terminal, safe context selector, pending/result state, no-focus state, and cleanup receipt. If no real browser driver is available, return the exact availability evidence and the smallest unblocked manual/browser command; do not claim PASS.
SCOPE: Read ui/src/remote/**, UI scripts/config, and package dependencies. You may start a local Vite/static fixture server only for QA, use real browser/agent-browser if installed, and clean it up. Do not modify source/tests, git state, app desktop UI, or user desktop. Do not expose actual paths in screenshots/fixture payloads.
VERIFY: Use a literal browser action scenario against a server fixture that returns state with one activeSessionId and a distinct background session: PASS iff the screenshot contains the active title/context and not the background title/path; trigger the selector request and capture pending/confirmed visual state; run a no-active-state fixture and capture useful empty state. Record local server PID cleanup and closed browser context.
STOP WHEN: Return captured real-browser evidence and cleanup receipt, or an exact factual QA-driver block.
